Sara,

Thanks for the note and the procurement file — appreciate the timeline context. I've sketched a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that aligns with your Oct 28 procurement milestone and includes explicit owners for each milestone. Key callouts below; full MAP attached (ellum_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Summary milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (Oct 18–22): Kickoff + environment provisioning (Owner: Marissa Cole, Redwood)
- Week 1 (Oct 25–29): Secure config & data handoff (Owner: Ellum ops / Sara) — deliver SFTP creds, test dataset, KMS service account
- Week 2 (Nov 1–5): Initial model validation & smoke tests (Owner: Ben Carter, Redwood); integration pivot for routing & auth
- Week 3 (Nov 8–12): Performance tuning + canary in staging (Owner: Marissa); prefix caching and batching config applied
- Week 4 (Nov 15–19): Production cutover window (Owner: Marissa + on-call rotation); rollback policy documented

Risks / dependencies:
- Procurement sign-off on or before Oct 28 (path to SOW execution)
- SOC2 evidence & KMS integration must be validated in Week 1 — request: access to the HSM test endpoint by Oct 26
- Data privacy review for PHI flows — Ellum to confirm redaction approach by Oct 25

Next steps I need from Ellum this week:
1) Confirm Marissa as your primary Redwood technical owner for provisioning and cutover (we've already looped her).
2) Provide SFTP test credentials and a 10k-row anonymized sample by EOD Fri Oct 22.
3) Confirm legal procurement date (you mentioned Oct 28) so Marissa can schedule the cutover window.

Attachments: ellum_MAP_v1.xlsx, redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf

I'll follow up with a short internal note assigning detailed tasks and on-call windows. If any of the milestone dates are aggressive for Ellum, let me know and we can slide Week 2/3 by one week.

Regards,

Sara / team — quick confirmation from validation side. I've added a lightweight test harness (python pytest + sample payloads) to the MAP folder and annotated the validation sheet with acceptance criteria. Highlights:

- Functional: 95% of classification prompts must match baseline on the 10k test subset; discrepancy > 5% raises a QA ticket and pushes cutover
- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 220ms, p99 < 300ms in staging with 4 concurrent connections (we'll tune batch size if needed)
- Security checks: tokenization logging disabled for PHI tokens; KMS rotate key check passed in my local run (will need the HSM endpoint to fully validate)
